u.n: Evidence says only that it is not mind over matter; it does not characterize it as positive-thinking technique.
Evidence contrasts lived reality with intellectual idea but does not supply the sermon example or this expanded description of facing one's ending.
The evidence does not guarantee that every believer will have a fearless death.
